title: Apple and rhubarb pots with nutty crunch

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Apples, rhubarb, honey, orange, nuts, seeds, butter, sugar and natural yoghurt are all plain kitchen staples.

supermarket.reason: Every item, including rhubarb, almonds and pumpkin seeds, is an everyday Tesco purchase at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: Only needs a saucepan, a frying pan, a knife and bowls, using simple stewing and toasting.

works.reason: Covered Bramley and rhubarb collapse well in 10 minutes with orange juice, and the fruit, 400g yoghurt and 80g crunch make four generous pots, though the compote will be on the sharp side.

honest_times.reason: 15 minutes covers peeling and chopping three apples, the rhubarb, the zest and the almonds, and 30 minutes of cook time covers the stewing, toasting and cooling.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and the cinnamon appear in the steps, and nothing unlisted is used.

seasonal_feel.reason: Stored Bramleys with early garden rhubarb suit 9 April, and the apples are the bulk of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Fruit, yoghurt, nuts and seeds with modest added sugar make a proper, appealing snack.
